metadata.variable: Warm CPU-source DataTexture aliases a complete dirty row band with full-width stride, source y rebased to zero and original destination x/y; physical rectangle bytes, public-copy count, complete GPU scratch domain and original mip generation/copy remain unchanged.
metadata.scope: Preparation provenance only; CPU mock is not native GPU sRGB mip proof or a performance result.
metadata.modelLimits: All modeled RGBA mip bytes are checked using deterministic integer-box arithmetic, not native GPU sRGB filtering. Failure injection occurs after modeled public copy completion, not between internal Three UNPACK setup/restoration; context lifecycle is modeled dispose/recreate, not real context loss.

result.scope: Both complete original and candidate providers run every mode; full modeled base/scratch/destination mip RGBA SHA sequences match per mode. Actual byte arrays are independently checked against full input/model before hashing. Integer-box CPU mips are NOT native GPU sRGB filtering; real WebGL native mip/context proof and whole-frame timing are separate. Initial/v2 tools and their failure/pass evidence remain untouched.

scope: Deterministic CPU contract model. No Canvas/browser/GL or performance benchmark. Full providers and one pinned region helper are bundled with one public Three identity. Native sRGB mip RGBA and frame timing require independent GPU proof/ABBA.
